name: thesis-mcwm-closed-loop-diagnostic-v2-20261020
selection: All five previously fixed seeds; no outcome based subsetting or protocol tuning. Diagnostic observations do not alter updates.
data_rights: Each arm receives exactly five distinct completed positive-time nonterminal target records per fixed clock window, with available_at no later than the deadline. Missing packets fail explicitly. Select latest eligible records by time, never by outcomes. No unselected target outcome enters learning or family/context selection.
prediction_comparison: One frozen same-seed IQL behavior actor generates a common stream; frozen historical model reference, online and context models receive identical packets. A1 has no intrinsic world model; frozen reference is diagnostic only. Score the family selected at issue, before learning.
control_comparison: Each arm controls its own complete target day under equal seeds, scenario, history, source buffer, initialization, feedback times/record counts and policy-update budget. The full passenger ledger including unfinished passengers determines costs.
source_budget: Same archived 4096-row source sample for all arms. No extra policy-dependent source collection in this model-isolation comparison.
interpretation: Five paired training-seed units; 300-second bins are not independent replicates. Stable counterparts define degradation and recovery. Preserve missing, censored and failed states. Original frozen experiments are read only.
purpose: Development diagnosis, not a new formal confirmation. Preserve the prior frozen experiment and formal campaign read only.
physical_prediction: Source-only frozen interval prior vs online linear adaptation vs the same online model plus per-line fast context; common fixed IQL behavior. Separate diagnostic labels never enter policy or the global world model.
physical_budget: All released direct same-trip next-stop intervals with available_at<=18000; count separately per line and period. Identical labels for three physical predictors; no equality claim with the 285 global feedback records.
td_comparison: real1:1*real; real075:0.75*real; model/context:0.75*real+0.25*absolute-trust-weighted-model. Match policy update budget and initializer; first update of each feedback packet records loss/gradient/parameter diagnostics.
source_calibration: One new source simulator day, fixed 6201 IQL behavior, collect first at most64 actual direct intervals per line. No target data in source prior.
result_scope: Diagnose global versus affected-route predictions, gradient scale/alignment and model TD versus real-TD scaling. Decide the next formal protocol only after this diagnostic batch.
